investment_theses.thesis: Oil prices (WTI/Brent) will oscillate above $90/barrel through H2 2026 as Trump Iran escalation persists; long energy sector (XLE) outperformance vs. SPY on supply-side risk premium.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Trump rejects Iranian Strait reopening proposal; oil jumps 4%+.

BBC: Iran bomb plot investigation at UK air base—escalation narrative intact.
investment_theses.counter_view: Global recession fears or Saudi/UAE production surge could oversupply market and crater prices below $80; Trump may quickly reverse Iran stance to boost domestic economy (election risk).

investment_theses.thesis: Nvidia (NVDA) faces near-term headwind from Trump tariff/export ban risks (semiconductor supply chain disruption) but long-term AI agent safety software platform (announced May 2026) creates enterprise software moat. Trim near-term exposure; hold long-term core.
supporting_signals: CNBC: Nvidia releases AI agent safety software platform; HuggingFace incident prevention tied to product differentiation.
Trump policy signals: diesel export ban, tariff expansions—supply chain risk for semiconductor fabrication/logistics.
Hacker News: 'Owed a billion dollars in Nvidia stock' discussion suggests retail overleverage; technical weakness possible.
